cases.input: Issue A pins definition v1.2, parameters, input snapshots, cutoff, run and disclosure policy.
cases.expect: The issue is immutable, explainable and identifier-distinct from run, record and publication.

cases.input: An upstream correction changes the report inputs.
cases.expect: Issue B supersedes A with new snapshots and execution evidence while A remains resolvable.

cases.input: A sensitive slice is withheld under policy.
cases.expect: The issue records policy version and suppression reason without storing the withheld value in the manifest.

cases.input: A published issue is updated in place after correction.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; a successor issue is required.

cases.input: A changing dashboard URL is cited as a fixed report issue.
cases.expect: The citation is rejected until a frozen evidence-bearing snapshot exists.

cases.input: One projection joins arbitrary HR and financial objects without rights and disclosure checks.
cases.expect: The issue is rejected because neither report definition nor aggregation bypasses policy and rights checks.

cases.input: Execution evidence omits part of the declared reporting period.
cases.expect: Issuance fails unless an explicit coverage exception is recorded and permitted by policy.

cases.input: A publication case references a report statement still in computed state.
cases.expect: The publication reference is rejected until the report issue reaches issued state.

cases.input: A dashboard snapshot has filters and a cutoff but no complete execution evidence.
cases.expect: No report issue is minted; the view remains ephemeral and non-citable.

cases.input: A computed issue has no record rendition yet and later receives two artifact renditions.
cases.expect: The computed state remains valid; issuance requires the evidence tuple, while zero-to-many external artifact references may be attached without merging identities.

cases.input: A producer sets asOfAt before cutoffAt or issuedAt before asOfAt.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the issue because reportingPeriod.end, cutoffAt, asOfAt and issuedAt must be ordered.

cases.input: An issue introduces a query binding absent from the pinned definition version.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the issue because resolved bindings may narrow or instantiate, but never exceed, the definition bindings.
